text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: added can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) to logistics/access.py, using road_status: False for CLOSED ('X'), light vehicles only for RESTRICTED ('R'), all vehicles for OPEN ('A'). P2: added passable_route(warehouse_id, site, network=None) to logistics/routes.py — picks the shortest route (min by (km, id)) among routes where a truck or a van may use every road, returning (route, 'truck') if a truck can use every road else (route, 'van'), or None; left best_route unchanged. Also added rerouted_sites(network=None), which lists sites in name order where passable_route picks a route with a different id than best_route (vehicle-only changes don't count). P3: added notify_rerouted(sites, day) to notifications/sms.py — sends one DELIVERY_MOVED text via queue_sms to each active household whose site is in sites and whose sms_ok is True, returning the messages sent. P4: in distribution/planner.py build_plan, replaced best_route with passable_route, setting delivery.route_id and delivery.vehicle from the (route, vehicle) result and keeping status='unreachable' when None.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]}}
